verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Weave evaluates application responses using LLM judges alongside custom scorers, and describe evaluating single- and multi-turn agents scored with an LLM judge. Custom scorers can be written as function-based or class-based (weave.Scorer subclasses), and predefined scorers such as hallucination detection and summarization quality are available. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of judge configuration (judge model selection, prompt/rubric templates), no independent or hands-on corroboration.
